svg.title: Compare observed reach with usable scratching height
svg.desc: Hypothetical observed paw reach of 30 inches and existing 22 inch usable post surface. The 8 inch gap is a prompt to investigate, not a universal post-height rule.

g.text: Start with the stretch you actually see
Also check stability, texture and placement before replacing the post.
Hypothetical example, not a breed-wide minimum. Schematic, not to scale.
